name: catgen-online
description: CatGen Online - a 2D browser-based Warrior Cats multiplayer game

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @catgen/client && npm run build -w @catgen/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/client --noEmit && tsc -p tools --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
